name: Guru
source:
The founder of a new religious group with branches nationwide.
After the previous battle with the Setsuna, he went missing for a while, but reappeared to get the sacred sword, “Amagumo no Ken.”
After getting the sword, he disappeared again.

[Translated from the [url=https://www.guilty-soft.com/product/Nightmare_x_Sisters_Omega/]official site[/url]]
